model_annotations.Bulgarian: The diagram is a circular chart with multiple concentric rings, each divided into sectors that represent different categories of characters and influencers. The innermost ring has two sectors labeled "Virtual Characters" and "Real Characters." Surrounding this are six sectors representing "Custom Characters," "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters." These sectors are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top of the circle and are color-coded in shades of blue and pink. The second outer ring contains six smaller sectors labeled "Scientists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers." These are uniformly colored in green. The third and outermost ring contains a partial view of a sector labeled "Comic Characters." The diameter of each ring suggests a hierarchy, with the inner rings being larger and the outer rings being smaller. The chart does not include any percentages or statistics.
model_annotations.English: The chart features a divided outer rose with distinct outer segments indicating categories of characters and real characters, each in a different color: a larger segment of light blue for Virtual Characters, encompassing a variety of sub-categories including Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters; and a smaller overlaying segment in dark blue for Real Characters. Additionally, there are two bokeh-style inner segments: a central segment in green labeled 'Custom Characters', and a smaller segment towards the outer edge of the outer rose in pink labeled 'Scientists Artists Athletes', each also part of a repeated microrose around the inner rose segment. The color distinctions make each category visually distinct, yet the circular design illustrates a thematic connection among the categories, with the inner microroses and bokeh-style segments highlighting specific subsets related to real characters, such as Scientists, Artists, and Athletes.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Circular Diagram kategorisiert verschiedene Arten von Charakteren und ihre jeweilige Beziehung zur virtuellen Realität. Es teilt dieses interstellares Zusammenspiel in drei Hauptsegmente, die jeweils verschiedene Strömungen und Sphären darstellen: Virtual Characters, Real Characters und Custom Characters. Innerhalb jedes Segments gibt es weiter unterteilte Kategorien, die jeweils eine eigenständige Gruppe von Charakterformen oder professionellen Akteuren darstellen, etwa Game Characters, Movie Characters, Novel Characters und Teleplay Characters im Segment von Virtual Characters. Des Weiteren bezieht sich das Segement von Real Characters auf Künstlergemeinschaften, einschließlich Wissenschaftler, Musiker und Schriftsteller. Das Diagramm ist prägnant und visuell auf eine Kombination aus Blau und Rosa angewandt, wobei der Hauptzweck darin liegt, einen Widerspiegelbild-vielen Dimensionen zu repräsentieren, die das interstellare Verweben von Zeichnen und realen Darstellungen in der digitalen Welle einbinden, allerdings ohne explizite Prozentangaben oder Kennzeichnungen für jedes Segment.
